user_story: As a user, I want the login endpoint to return an error when the email field is empty so that I provide all required credentials.

negative.title: Login with empty email field
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with an empty email field and a valid password.
negative.expected_result: The response should return an error message indicating that the email field is required.

edge.title: Login with email field containing only whitespace
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with the email field containing only whitespace characters and a valid password.
edge.expected_result: The response should return an error message indicating that the email field is required.
